preface.p: An Act to consolidate and reform the law relating to the making, publication and citation of the legislation of Atlantis; to establish the Office of the Publishing Authority and to provide for its functions; to secure a right of public access to the official text of the law; to provide for the keeping of a register of legislation and for the evidentiary status of published text; to create offences relating to the integrity of the legislative record; to make provision for appeals; and for connected and incidental purposes.

preamble.p: WHEREAS it is expedient that the laws of Atlantis be published in a complete, authentic and current form, and that every person have access to the law by which that person is bound:
BE IT ENACTED by the Assembly of Atlantis, and by the authority of the same, as follows:

content.p: 1. This Act establishes the framework for the publication and citation of the legislation of Atlantis and secures a right of public access to the official text of the law.
2. In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires, "official text" means the text of a law incorporating every amendment in force at the material time, as published by the Publishing Authority.

SCHEDULE. The enactments set out in this Schedule are repealed to the extent specified, and any reference in another law to a repealed enactment is a reference to the corresponding provision of this Act.

mainBody.p: The Ordinances of Atlantis specified in this Schedule are repealed to the extent indicated: the Government Printer Ordinance, being Chapter 12 of the Laws, is repealed in whole; and the Interpretation Ordinance, being Chapter 1 of the Laws, is repealed in respect of section 40 only.
